final: WITH groups AS (SELECT pt.TrackId, mt.Name AS media_type_name, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM PlaylistTrack AS pt JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY pt.TrackId, mt.Name), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM groups) SELECT g.media_type_name, SUM(g.group_count), AVG(1.0 * g.group_count / totals.total_count) FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.total_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.media_type_name ORDER BY g.media_type_name
